{{Quote|I am Agent Craige Graf, Imperial Intelligence. It was no accident those Killiks attacked when they did. The Ulgos pushed them toward that mine.|Craige Graf|<ref name="Hive Mined">{{TORcite|type=general|Hive Mined|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''Craige Graf''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agent who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Craige was part of an Inspection team during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] until they were captured by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. They were later freed by an Imperial spacer.<ref name="Hive Mined" />

He and [[Stanel Andaren Thul]] later tasked the Imperial spacer with destroying a nearby [[Ulgo Fortress|fortress of House Ulgo]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Pre-Emptive Strike|Alderaan}}</ref>
